jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 Flipp + Shopfully’s Product team focuses on driving adoption and revenue of our products by identifying the biggest market opportunities, building the case for investing in them, and shipping solutions with engineering, all while representing the voice of our merchant customers. About the role The Senior Product Manager is a senior, commercially minded product leader who already understands digital advertising. This role requires a strong strategic thinker with good business sense and solid hands-on product skills who leads opportunity identification, builds decision-ready business cases, and works with engineering to ship. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Data, and Marketing teams across markets to align on key business objectives. By combining market insight, customer feedback, and industry trends, you will make sure our products resonate with merchants and drive growth. We’re looking for someone who can ramp up quickly and contribute independently. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Market Understanding and Opportunity Identification Work with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams to understand customer needs and prioritize the opportunities that matter most. Find the highest-leverage areas to invest in, and weigh customer demand against our resources, capabilities

jobs.description: Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie. Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels. Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes. jobs.description: Who are we At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel. By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost. Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control. Location While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain. This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms. About We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next. Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most. We're hiring across multiple domains , so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand. We're building an AI-native engineering culture where engineers take ownership of problems

jobs.title: Software Platform Engineer, EU Traffic
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the Company Help us build the world's most reliable, on-demand logistics engine for last-mile delivery! We're bringing on experienced engineers to help us create and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers the company's three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and riders. About the Role We are looking for experienced engineers to join the EU Traffic team, based at Deliveroo, part of DoorDash, and help build the next generation of DoorDash's Traffic platform. We are building a single, shared platform designed to serve DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt, so your work will shape reliability and security for all three marketplaces. Our team owns the infrastructure that carries every request into and through that platform: the edge, where we manage Cloudflare (CDN, DNS, rate limiting, bot mitigation) and the ingress systems for external traffic, and service-to-service (S2S) communication, where we run the service mesh and the authentication that secures calls between thousands of services across multiple regions. You will work on core components of our traffic stack, including our Cloudflare edge configuration (managed as code), and service-to-service authentication and authorization (workload identity, token issuance and validation at the mesh layer). This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and security. It includes designing, building, and maintaining systems that must operate reliably and efficiently across some of the most critical and latency-sensitive workloads at DoorDash, from the first byte at the edge to the last hop between services. You will report to the Engineering Manager of the EU-Traffic Team

Create and mature airframe integration concepts, including interfaces to systems like landing gear, propulsion battery installation, electrical routing, interiors, etc. Work with analysis engineers to ensure designs are structurally sound, weight-efficient, inspectable, repairable, and suitable for certification. Create high-quality 3D models, assemblies, installation layouts, model-based definitions (MBD), and configuration-controlled design data. Drive design-for-manufacturing for metallic and composite structures. Support prototype manufacturing, supplier reviews, structural testing, non-conformance resolution, and design improvements. jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst (FP&A) (Contractor)
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to lead end-to-end financial planning, reporting, and forecasting for operating expenses across the organization. In this role, you will own cost center analysis, drive forecast consolidation, manage systems integrity between TM1 and NetSuite, and serve as a strategic finance business partner to department leaders across the company. The ideal candidate brings strong financial modeling expertise, hands-on experience with corporate planning tools, and the confidence to constructively challenge operational teams on budget assumptions while translating complex numbers into actionable business narratives. Responsibilities: Own the FP&A OpEx close—analyzing variances, preparing monthly management reporting packs (P&L, dashboards, board inputs), and partnering with Accounting on accruals and prepayments. Own planning, trend analysis, and variance commentary for non-people OpEx (software, marketing, T&E, professional services). Track cost efficiency metrics and ensure accurate TM1 mapping. Lead annual OpEx budget cycles and recurring reforecasts. Build dynamic, driver-based forecasting models and support Long-Range Planning (LRP) scenario modeling. Consolidate OpEx, workforce, and revenue forecasts into a single defensible group view in TM1. Support the FP&A Director in presenting to the CFO, ELT, and Board. Act as the strategic finance partner to department heads - translating numbers into actionable insights, constructively challenging spend assumptions, and flagging risks/opportunities. Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform. Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt. Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren. Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung? Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann. Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausge

We value clarity over cleverness, lean into autonomy, and treat writing well and first-principles thinking as core parts of the job. We avoid jargon, favor plain English, and focus on helping customers and prospects genuinely understand what our product does and how it can help them. What we’re looking for We're looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own our Enterprise narrative, content and enable our go-to-market teams with clarity and confidence. jobs.title: Support Engineering Manager - NAMER
jobs.description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby . I’m excited to share that we’re hiring our first Support Engineering Manager in AMER. Support Engineering is the technical bridge between frontline Support, Product, and Engineering. The team investigates complex product and customer issues, helps confirm which problems truly require code changes, and enables the broader Support organization to resolve more issues independently. We’re looking for a hands-on leader to make that bridge stronger as the function grows—aligning technical rigor with Ashby’s broader standards for customer success. This is not a traditional Support Manager role. You’ll manage and mentor Support Engineers, stay close to complex investigations, and work with Engineering and Product to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, escalated, and resolved. You’ll help define the standards and systems that let a small, highly technical team move quickly without sacrificing judgment or quality. About the role When a complex issue moves beyond frontline Support, Support Engineering investigates the problem using customer context, application behavior, logs, databases, integrations, APIs, and code-level context. The team determines whether the issue can be resolved through configuration, data correction, documentation, enablement, or an in-app change—or whether it is a product defect that Engineering needs to fix. Your role is to make that path clearer and more effective: develop a deep understanding of how each partner team works, coach the investigation, and ensure escalations meet a shared standard for evidence, ownership, and customer impact. You’ll lead the team’s day-to-day technical development while building the connective tissue around it. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description: Hi! I'm Chris , head of Product Design at Ashby . We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on. Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet. How We Work In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers. We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager. This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. As we scale from Alpha customer readiness toward Production and Volume Readiness, securing the right components at the right price and lead time – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs and mechanical parts – becomes mission-critical. The role As Procurement & Supply Chain Lead, you will own the purchasing and supply chain for the materials, equipment, parts and services that keep our prototype, pilot and volume production on track – from negotiating with suppliers to coordinating with contract manufacturers and logistics partners. You will partner closely with Engineering to translate technical requirements into sourcing decisions, and help build our purchasing processes as we scale. This role is for you if you’ve negotiated with component suppliers yourself, like being hands-on, and enjoy building processes rather than following them – ideally with experience buying electronic components for B2B hardware such as power electronics, industrial equipment or automation systems. It isn’t for you if you prefer managing a team, require an established ERP and approval chain to work well, or a clearly defined, stable scope. It would not be a fit if your procurement background is mainly consumer goods, retail or indirect spend without hands-on exposure to electronic components. What you will do Contract and purchase raw materials, equipment, tools, parts, services and supplies needed for prototype, pilot and volume production. Negotiate pricing, terms and delivery schedules with suppliers for critical components – power semiconductors, magnetics, PCBs, and mechanical/enclosure parts. jobs.title: Experimental Quantum Engineer
jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors. With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! QuantWare is seeking an Experimental Quantum Engineer to join our growing Operations team. The mission of QuantWare’s Operations team is to consistently deliver high quality quantum hardware and make advanced quantum technologies accessible to customers all over the world. Together with your colleague Experimental Quantum Engineers, you will be in charge of several state of the art cryogenic setups. You’ll use these setups to perform advanced qubit measurements and guarantee the quality of all devices before they are shipped to customers. Whenever you spot abnormalities, you’ll search for root causes and countermeasures, together with your colleagues from Fabrication or Design. Product volume and complexity of our products increase - so the challenge is to stay one step ahead by continuously improving our measurement setups, software and processes. What you will be doing Own QuantWare’s cryogenic measurement setups: purchase and build them, and keep them state-of-the-art (maintenance, upgrades). Manage the hands-on physical operation of cryogenic quantum hardware, working directly with the dilution refrigerators. Develop measurement code to implement and refine Python-based routines for device characterization. jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. The role We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team. Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. jobs.description: About the Role We are hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our team. You will own how DataSnipper’s products are understood and chosen in a crowded AI landscape. You will be the voice of competition, the buyer, and the message across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product. You will join a small Product Marketing team where your work directly affects pipeline growth globally. About DataSnipper We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. What You Will Do Competitive Intelligence Own competitive intelligence end-to-end: track competitors, draft the insight, and turn it into positioning. Build and maintain battlecards, objection handling, and playbooks for Sales and Marketing. Partner closely with Sales and Product leadership to ensure content is used, measurable, and effective.

Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience. The role We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on. This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU. What you'll work on Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes. Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences. jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. WHY THIS ROLE, WHY NOW R&D leaders trust people who have done the science. More than half of the world's top 50 biopharma companies already use Benchling, and many of the most important are in Europe. Our ambition is 10x faster science, from idea to first dose. With Science Foundries, launched at Benchtalk 2026, agents and scientists run entire R&D workflows together, so a three-person team can have the productive capacity of thirty. In a senior R&D role, you can change how one organisation does science. As our Field CSO, you'll take one question to R&D organisations across EMEA: how do we get from idea to first dose 10x faster? Too often it arrives as a Slack post or a long deck, and sellers never really pick it up. As Revenue Enablement Manager, Just-in-Time Enablement, you own that last mile. You are the front door between the teams who create news and the teams who use it, and you make sure every launch reaches Sales, Customer Success and Partnerships across Europe at the right time, in a format they can use in their next conversation. What you'll do: Run the launch intake. Be the single entry point for PMM, Product, Marketing and others who want something to reach the field. Prioritize with clear criteria so sellers aren't overloaded. Own the field release calendar. Keep one view of what's coming, when, and for whom, shared with creators and sales managers. Turn launches into what sellers need. Shape each release into: what's new, who it's for, why customers care, how to talk about it, and how to handle the likely questions. Coach the creators. Brief PMM, Product and Marketing on what the field needs and review their materials before they go out. When the input is raw (specs, messaging docs, long decks), write the enablement content yourself: short, clear and practical. Deliver just in time. Pick the right format and moment: a 20-minute live session, a short recording, a one-pager, a talk track. Not so early it's forgotten, not so late it's useless. Make it stick. jobs.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. jobs.description: Wil jij, met inzet van moderne technieken, zorg dragen voor het fysieke en virtuele netwerk van het CBS en hiermee de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid maximaliseren? Heb je daarnaast affiniteit met het automatiseren van beheer en hersteltaken? Dan biedt het CBS jou een unieke kans! Waar jij het verschil maakt Je levert en ontwikkelt diensten op basis van virtuele netwerktechnieken en beheert en onderhoudt deze; Je zorgt voor de continuïteit van het CBS door het fysieke netwerk te onderhouden, te ontwikkelen en te beheren, zowel in het datacenter als op kantoorlocaties. Je werkt aan de bescherming van onze omgeving middels beheer van firewalls, microsegmentatie, proxy servers en application delivery controllers; Je werkt aan het maximaal automatiseren van beheertaken en het bieden van autonomie aan afnemende teams Je hebt affiniteit met het aanbieden van infrastructuurdiensten als selfservice en door middel van ‘Infrastructure-as-Code’. Je toekomstige collega's Je werkt in het Team IaaS van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives. De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. jobs.description: À propos de Dastra Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA . Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle , en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises. Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover , en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables . Le rôle En tant que Data Migration Project Manager , tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison. À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client , ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %) , tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données. Tes missions Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité. Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins. Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra Comprendre & structurer la data Analyser et structurer les données sources du client Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisée

jobs.description: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity What You’ll Deliver Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents. Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). jobs.description: We are hiring a General Counsel , reporting to the Chief Operating Officer (COO). This role leads Canonical ’s global Legal and Compliance function. We’re looking for someone with genuine fluency in the software industry and in open source dynamics, who can translate that insight into clear positions on licensing, commercial contracts and risk, and hands-on execution. You will work closely with our product and engineering teams on licensing and IP questions, with the security function on customer assurance, and you will advise the Board and its committees directly. In our selection process, we prioritize intellect and judgement alongside depth of practice. Location: This role will be based remotely in EMEA time zones. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . About the role You’ll run Morpho’s corporate IT: accounts and access, laptops, and the SaaS tools the company runs on, all set up securely. You’ll work closely with the security team: they set policy and lead on incidents, and you put that policy in place across our tools and devices. The scope is broad and the work is hands-on. We’d rather automate repetitive work than hire for it, so expect to write scripts and build your own tooling, using AI where it helps. We’ll go through our stack with you early in the process. jobs.description: About EH Group Engineering EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To help achieve our vision of a decarbonised future we are seeking Mechanical Engineers to design components and assemblies for our compact, high power density fuel cell products.
